paper.paper_scope: Develops a data-driven yield-strength prediction framework (GMM-augmented dataset of four strengthening-mechanism contributions + GA-optimized Extra Trees) for medium-manganese low-density steels, validated on an experimental Fe-0.25C-3Mn-2Al-0.4Si steel annealed at 750–850 °C and on literature data.
paper.title: Data-driven and multi-mechanism strengthening based yield strength prediction in medium-manganese low-density steels

unmapped_findings: The YS prediction framework was trained on 177 literature-mined data entries quantifying contributions of four strengthening mechanisms (solid solution, grain refinement, dislocation, Orowan) plus YS, augmented via Gaussian Mixture Model to 776 entries.
Through ensemble learning comparison of seven models, GA-optimized Extra Trees was selected as the best model, achieving RMSE=31.60 MPa, MAPE=4.39%, and R²=0.997 on the test set.

The two literature validation steels (Fe-0.29C-12.14Mn-2.96Al-0.11V-0.063Nb and Fe-9.7Mn-2.04Al-0.99Si-0.52V-0.42C) were each evaluated with three data points under unspecified experimental conditions, so no process/sample entities could be defined for them.
